resume: Drone synth: two always-on drones that you tune, shape and set in motion rather than play note by note. The keys are not notes: the twelve lower white keys hold presets and scenes, the top four are gestures, the black keys are switches.

commandes.role: LFO I waveform: press for the next; with SEL, the previous.
LFO II waveform: press for the next; with SEL, the previous.
Held: fine adjustment. SEL + an upper white key selects the scene bank (D5 A, E5 B, F5 C, G5 Presets); SEL + PLAY brings drone II in or out.
Saves the sound right away. SAVE held then a white key stores the sound in that slot.
Press: turns Swell on or off (both drones chopped in time).
Fades the drones in or out.
Records your knob movements, then loops them, then stops (up to 5 minutes).
Gesture duration, from ten times faster to ten times slower.
Movement: all LFO depths together, from still to double.
The lower twelve (F3 to C5) recall scenes; pressing harder crossfades to the scene. The top four (D5 to G5) are the gestures Weight, Shift, Clean, Wash.
Switches (lit = active): partner, sub, filter, pitch lock, links between drones. On the LFO pages, they set the LFO routing.

gestes: Gesture (top key) held: it comes in, then goes back out as slowly as you held it; a short press sets it, a second one removes it.
SEL held when releasing a gesture: keeps it where it is.

modes.texte: Three banks A, B, C that are yours (twelve scenes each) and the fixed Presets bank, with twelve starter sounds. A new FM-1 starts on Presets.

a_savoir: Pitch lock is on at first startup: turning a pitch knob shows PITCH LOCKED, black key 4 turns it off.
Nothing can be stored in the Presets bank: use A, B or C.
